note: Single-probe capture for issue #97: the exact { NULL: false } PutItem rejection message in every region the sweep observes (registry/regions.json). The rejection is request-level validation thrown before table resolution - verified in eu-west-2, where a nonexistent table name returns the same message - so the probe fires one PutItem per region against a nonexistent _conformance_ table name and creates no tables. Two message forms, differing only by the leading 1-validation-error-detected envelope: six regions prefixed, twenty-seven bare. Each region block follows the capture-block shape scripts/lib/drift.mjs reads ({ probes, nullRoundTrip }); the observation lives on nullRoundTrip and probes is empty because only this one input was fired, so scripts/drift-diff.mjs can diff regions within this file. me-south-1 did not answer (issue #93) and sits under unreachable, outside regions, so absence is never read as agreement.
